headline: Colts' Keenan Allen formally charged, faces two misdemeanors
summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was formally charged with two misdemeanor drunken driving charges on Wednesday.

headline: Falcons QB unclear with injured Cooper Rush, Tua Tagovailoa
summary: Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski said he's "not ruling anybody out" when it comes to which QB is starting against the Panthers on Sunday.

headline: Chiefs will have Mansoor Delane at Wednesday's practice
summary: Word on Tuesday was that Chiefs cornerback Mansoor Delane avoided a serious shoulder injury in Monday night's win over the Broncos and the first-round pick is set to be back on the field right away.

headline: Browns QB Watson: Focus on winning, not job security
summary: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson said Wednesday that his focus is on getting a win in Week 2, not his job security or the potential fan reception awaiting him in the team's home opener in Week 3.

headline: 49ers to put WR De'Zhaun Stribling on injured reserve
summary: 49ers rookie wide receiver De'Zhaun Stribling will miss at least four games due to the ankle injury he suffered in last Thursday's season-opening win over the Rams.

headline: Could Carson Wentz play his way into the Vikings' QB1 job?
summary: Wentz performed well in Week 1. If it continues, the Vikings could stick with the hot hand.
